description: Consumer fixture manifest for the dagr-commerce-contracts C1 conformance gate. Each fixture exercises only protocol-neutral fields from the commerce evidence vocabulary; protocol-specific adapters remain in their own repositories. All fixtures must validate against the referenced commerce schema.
disclaimer: Every fixture here is a SYNTHETIC, protocol-neutral, shared-contract example. Protocol names (x402, ACP, AP2, UCP, Visa-TAP) identify only the native protocol family the shared vocabulary projects from. No fixture establishes any authority, approval, certification, or conformance of, by, or with any named protocol, program, or organization, and none is an adapter or reference implementation of that protocol. In particular the Visa-TAP fixture establishes NO Visa authority, NO Visa approval, NO Visa conformance, NO TAP implementation, and NO T0 resolution (T0 is on HOLD).
